cards.headline: A sibling track: Chrome Country echoes a film commission
cards.snippet: In 2012, Daniel Lopatin, who records as Oneohtrix Point Never, composed "Meet Your Creator" for the film Quadrotor, shown at that year's New Directors' Showcase put on by the agency Saatchi & Saatchi. When the track was later collected on the 2014 Warp EP Commissions I, Fact magazine critic Maya Kalev heard it as the closest match to "Chrome Country" and "Problem Areas", two cuts from the 2013 album R Plus Seven. His reasoning was that all three have Lopatin zooming in on tiny textural details and solitary figures, rendering them in pin-sharp detail.
cards.context: From the Commissions I EP review coverage; Chrome Country is on R Plus Seven (2013).

cards.headline: Sunrise over the clouds, on an overnight flight
cards.snippet: As soon as Chrome country came on the sun had started rising and all the clouds had a perfect orange and red hue. Needless to say that shit HIT, like I was crying on a damn plane.
cards.context: The song closes R+7, and this listener hit it just as dawn broke at altitude.

replies.text: Damn what a feeling that was:o

replies.author: @DJ_CARCINOGEN
replies.text: I still cant listen to chrome country without breaking down in tears. Theres not a single other song that can do this to me. That organ, man it just crushes my soul.

cards.headline: Crying at work, cause unknown
cards.snippet: im delivering packages for amazon and crying, not really sure why
cards.context: Captures the song's way of hitting hard without explanation.

cards.headline: Closing track of all time?
cards.snippet: Probably the greatest closing track of all time.
cards.context: Chrome Country ends R Plus Seven, and many commenters agree it's the high point.

replies.author: @thisseaisnotblue
replies.text: "You never were", Tim Hecker, Anoyo, but yes, that's one is gorgeous.

cards.headline: Acid at 17, and a song he'll remember at 80
cards.snippet: I honeslty just warped to another dimension. I'll be 80 and still think of this song.
cards.context: A trip-sitter put it on for a group of friends, and one of them never forgot it.

cards.headline: Chrome Country in a KCRW session recording
cards.snippet: A KCRW Session take of the track, released on Warp Records in 2019 and uploaded to OPN's own channel.

cards.headline: Live at Park Avenue Armory, encore to MYRIAD, 2018
cards.snippet: Recorded 22 May 2018 at Park Avenue Armory as the encore to MYRIAD, days before Age Of came out. Daniel Lopatin plays with drummer Eli Keszler and keyboardists Kelly Moran and Aaron David Ross.

cards.headline: Scoom Legacy's breaks remix with Sterling Fox vocal
cards.snippet: Scoom Legacy's free-download remix adds futuristic breaks to the melodic core of the track and Sterling Fox's vocal. It runs 6:49 and is meant to open or close a DJ set.
cards.context: Remix of the original, not an official OPN release.
